report.scene_summary: The video shows an industrial manufacturing floor with large machinery (presses) on the left and a marked pedestrian aisle on the right. Workers are observed moving through the aisle and standing near the machinery. A metal coil is stored on the floor near the machinery, and a pallet of materials is placed in the aisle. The scene is generally well-lit, though some areas near the machinery are darker.

findings.title: Obstruction of marked pedestrian aisle
findings.location: Right side of the facility, marked pedestrian aisle
findings.observation: A metal pallet loaded with materials is positioned directly on the marked pedestrian aisle (green painted path with yellow borders). The pallet obstructs the clear width of the designated walkway.
findings.risk_interpretation: Obstructed aisles can impede safe movement, create trip hazards, and block emergency egress routes.
findings.applicability_reason: The object is a stationary obstruction within a marked pedestrian path.
recommended_actions: Relocate the pallet to a designated storage area outside of marked walkways.
Ensure all aisles remain clear of stored materials at all times.

findings.title: Uncovered rotating machinery component
findings.observation: A large gear or sprocket on the side of the blue machine is exposed and lacks a physical guard. The component is located near the walkway where workers are present.
findings.risk_interpretation: Exposed rotating parts present a severe entanglement hazard to workers passing by or operating the machine.
findings.applicability_reason: The machine has a point of operation or rotating part that is accessible to workers.
recommended_actions: Install a fixed guard over the exposed gear.
Verify that all rotating parts are guarded before machine operation.

findings.title: Potential energy isolation during worker proximity
findings.observation: Workers are observed standing immediately adjacent to or inside the guarding of large presses. The energy state of the machines is unknown.
findings.risk_interpretation: If the machines are energized or in a cycle, workers are at risk of crushing or entanglement. If servicing, lack of visible lockout/tagout (LOTO) is a concern.
findings.applicability_reason: Worker proximity to hazardous machinery requires verification of energy control and guarding.
recommended_actions: Verify if machines are running or being serviced.
Ensure LOTO procedures are followed if maintenance is occurring.
Confirm guards are in place and functional.

dismissed.reason: Dark areas near machinery are likely shadows or unpolished concrete, not confirmed spills.

dismissed.concern: Circular metal object interpreted as rubber
dismissed.reason: The object is a metal coil, not a rubber hazard.
The path is a marked pedestrian aisle, not explicitly an emergency exit route.

limitations: No reliable floor-like mask found; static-zone ranking uses general scene candidates.
Machine energy state and servicing status cannot be determined from still frames.
PPE compliance (e.g., eye protection) cannot be verified due to image resolution.
